messages:
sam: grabbing a ticket from support — customer 82713 reporting intermittent 502s from hosted API since ~11:20 PST, spikes every 20-30s. curl shows intermittent 502 with empty body. attaching sample below.

alex: thanks — do we have a repro curl + headers? any tenant id or special header?

sam: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Tenant: acme-prod" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" --data '{"prompt":"hello"}'

sam: response snippet: 
HTTP/2 502
content-length: 0

(no body)

irene: seeing same traces in edge logs for that tenant, pattern: upstream reset while keepalive connection still active. envoy upstream_reset_reason=SOCKET_READ; upstream host=10.4.2.18:8443

irene: paste of envoy log line: 
[2024-04-03T18:21:10.123Z] "POST /v1/generate" 502 UH 0 0 1 0 "-" "10.4.2.18:8443" "SOCKET_READ"

tom-oncall: checking listener stats on frontdoor: accept_overflow_count jumped ~3k during spike window, backlog queue length peaked at 511. looks like accept queue exhaustion under short bursts. metrics: 
listener.accept_overflow: 3120
listener.backlog_peek: 511

priya: interesting — that points to OS accept queue / TCP backlog. are we seeing fd exhaustion too?

alex: also check nginx worker accept queue and keepalive_idle connections. if upstream (auth/cache) sometimes stalls, many front connections pile up and we hit backlog.

sam: customer says they were sending 40 concurrent short requests per client (~150 clients). traffic pattern is spiky.

priya: quick repro script suggestion: bombard endpoint with many short POSTs (concurrency 200, tiny payload) to reproduce. will run from infra lab.

[deploy-bot]: Deploy 2024-04-03T18:25:03 -> edge-proxy v2.14.3 started (sha: abc123) :rocket:

irene: note — deploy just after spike began, but logs show spike started before deploy. not sure deploy made it worse.

tom-oncall: temporary mitigation applied: increased socket backlog on frontdoor hosts, bumped sysctl net.core.somaxconn=10240 and net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=4096 on a small canary pool. also increased nginx worker_connections on canary.

sam: customer updated with mitigation and asked for ETA. they reported error rate dropped after canary change. :thumbsup:

alex: next actions: 1) run controlled loadtest to reproduce and confirm root cause (accept queue overflow), 2) audit long-lived upstreams (auth cache) for stalls and ensure proxy timeouts are aligned, 3) add alert for listener.accept_overflow > 100 in 5m.

priya: capturing tcpdump soon to confirm SYN queue vs ESTABLISHED backlog. will attach pcap+tcp_stat after run.

sam: update ticket 82713 that we applied canary backlog bump and will follow up with infra config change if stable. marking P1 -> monitoring.

alex: nice triage. add a note to run a rolling change with nginx keepalive tweak (reduce keepalive timeout for guest flows) to help clear stuck upstreams.

irene: also adding a trace sampling increase for tenant acme-prod to catch the next failure with full headers.

sam: thanks all — will follow up with ticket and paste traces once tcpdump and metrics are in.
